taxTips.title: Negative Gearing
taxTips.description: Off-set property losses against your taxable income.

taxTips.title: FHOG Grant
taxTips.description: First Home Owner Grant for new residential properties.

educationAdvice.concessionDescription: Australian commercial education lenders offer up to 0.50% p.a. interest discounts for servicing interest during study. Commonwealth HELP/HECS loans are indexed to CPI.
educationAdvice.bankingTip: In Australia, federal HELP/HECS debt does not incur commercial interest, but is indexed to CPI (or WPI, whichever is lower), with repayments starting only when income exceeds $54,435 AUD. For bank education loans, paying interest during term-time keeps your loan principal intact.

taxTips.title: Self-Education Expense Deductions
taxTips.description: Course fees and study loan interest can be claimed if directly related to your current employment.
taxTips.details: Reduces assessable taxable income under Australian Taxation Office guidelines.

taxTips.title: HELP Indexation Protection
taxTips.limitLabel: Capped to Lower of CPI or WPI
taxTips.description: Commonwealth government caps annual student debt indexation to preserve borrowing equity.
taxTips.details: Compulsory repayments are based on taxable income brackets, automatically withheld via PAYG.

taxTips.title: Amortização com FGTS
taxTips.description: Use your FGTS (Severance Indemnity Fund) to pay down up to 80% of mortgage installments or principal balance.

taxTips.title: Isenção de Ganho de Capital (Imóvel Residencial)
taxTips.description: Total capital gains tax exemption if property sale profits are reinvested in residential real estate within 180 days.

educationAdvice.concessionDescription: Federal FIES programs offer 0% or deeply subsidized interest rates, with commercial student credit (e.g. Pravaler) offering discounts for automated debit payments.
educationAdvice.bankingTip: In Brazil, federal financing through FIES provides grace periods (carência) of up to 18 months post-graduation, during which borrowers pay only trimestral insurance and interest charges. Paying interest regularly keeps total obligations manageable.

taxTips.title: Dedução de Despesas com Instrução (IRPF)
taxTips.description: Deduct direct higher education, graduate tuition, and technical study expenses on annual IRPF returns.
taxTips.details: Applies per student (taxpayer or declared dependents) on the annual Brazilian income tax declaration.

taxTips.title: Abatimento de Dívida FIES para Professores e Médicos
taxTips.description: Public school teachers and SUS medical professionals can abate 1% per month off their outstanding FIES balance.
taxTips.details: Federal incentive rewarding service in underserved regions and public health networks.

taxTips.title: First-Time Home Buyers' Tax Credit (HBTC)
taxTips.description: Non-refundable federal tax credit under CRA Line 31270 for qualifying first-time home purchasers.

taxTips.title: The Smith Maneuver (Mortgage Deductibility)
taxTips.description: Convert non-deductible residential mortgage interest into tax-deductible investment loan interest.

educationAdvice.concessionDescription: Major Canadian chartered banks (RBC, TD, Scotiabank) offer 0.25%–0.50% rate reductions when student borrowers enroll in pre-authorized debit (PAD).
educationAdvice.bankingTip: Federal Canada Student Loans (CSL) are 100% interest-free as of 2023! For provincial or commercial bank student lines of credit, servicing interest monthly during studies prevents debt escalation and protects your Canadian credit score (Equifax/TransUnion).

taxTips.title: Line 31900 - Student Loan Interest
taxTips.description: Claim 15% federal tax credit on interest paid on qualifying Canada Student Loans or provincial student loans.
taxTips.details: Can be carried forward for up to 5 consecutive years to offset future higher-income tax liabilities.

taxTips.title: Tuition Tax Credit (Schedule 11)
taxTips.description: Carry forward unused tuition amounts indefinitely or transfer up to $5,000 to parents or spouses.
taxTips.details: Reduces net federal and provincial tax liabilities when entering the post-graduation workforce.

taxTips.title: Housing Loan Interest Deduction (住房贷款利息专项附加扣除)
taxTips.description: Deduct ¥1,000 monthly from personal taxable income for first-time home mortgage interest for up to 240 months.

taxTips.title: Housing Provident Fund Benefits (住房公积金低息贷款)
taxTips.description: Access deeply discounted interest rates for first-time buyers through municipal Housing Provident Fund loans.

educationAdvice.concessionTitle: National Student Loan Subsidy: 100% In-Study Interest Free
educationAdvice.concessionDescription: China National Student Loans (国家助学贷款) are 100% interest-free during school, with all interest subsidized by central and local government fiscal budgets.
educationAdvice.bankingTip: Under China's national student loan program, loans accrue zero interest during degree study. After graduation, students benefit from a 5-year grace period where only interest is paid before principal amortization starts.

taxTips.title: Continuing Education IIT Deduction (继续教育专项附加扣除)
taxTips.description: Deduct ¥400/month for academic degree education, or ¥3,600 lump-sum for vocational qualification certificates.
taxTips.details: Applies directly under China's Individual Income Tax (IIT) special additional deduction system.

taxTips.title: National Interest Exemption Policies (国家助学贷款免息政策)
taxTips.description: Special periodic policies granting interest exemptions and deferred principal repayments for university graduates.
taxTips.details: Announced by the Ministry of Finance and People's Bank of China to ease youth transition into the workforce.

taxTips.title: Rentefradrag (Mortgage Interest Deduction)
taxTips.description: Deduct mortgage interest payments directly on your årsopgørelse tax assessment to lower net taxes.

taxTips.title: BoligJobordning / Håndværkerfradrag
taxTips.description: Tax deduction for home improvement, climate adaptation, and maintenance labor costs.

educationAdvice.concessionTitle: SU-lån Concession: Subsidized 4% In-Study Interest Rate
educationAdvice.concessionDescription: Statens Uddannelsesstøtte (SU) loans carry a government-subsidized 4.0% p.a. interest rate during enrollment, transitioning to discount rate + 1% upon graduation.
educationAdvice.bankingTip: In Denmark, SU-lån interest during study is 4% p.a., with a mandatory grace period of 1 to 2 years after completing your degree before repayment begins. Private bank student loans often offer interest rate reductions when linked to a NemKonto student account.

taxTips.title: SU-lån Interest Tax Deduction
taxTips.description: Interest accrued and paid on education loans is tax-deductible under Danish tax laws once repayment starts.
taxTips.details: Automatically reported by Udbetaling Danmark / SKAT to your annual tax return (årsopgørelse).

taxTips.title: Student Tax Exemption (Frikort)
taxTips.description: Students benefit from standard personfradrag (personal allowance) shielding scholarship grants and student earnings.
taxTips.details: Ensures students retain maximum income while managing part-time work and living expenses.

taxTips.title: Home Office Allowance
taxTips.description: Deduct home office expenses from your professional income.

taxTips.title: Professional Workspace
taxTips.description: Interest on investment properties is often tax-deductible.

educationAdvice.concessionDescription: European student loan programs (e.g., KfW Studienkredit, Erasmus+ master loans) provide subsidized interest rates and discounts if interest is serviced during study and grace periods.
educationAdvice.bankingTip: In the EU, public development banks (like Germany's KfW or Erasmus+ guarantee schemes) offer subsidized rates and flexible 18–24 month grace periods. Making regular interest payments during study prevents ballooning debt from accumulating prior to your first career job.

taxTips.title: Werbungskosten (Income-Related Costs)
taxTips.description: Master's degrees, second degrees, and study loan interest are 100% tax-deductible in Germany/EU.
taxTips.details: Accumulated study costs can be carried forward as tax losses to offset early career income.

taxTips.title: Sonderausgaben (First Degree Allowance)
taxTips.description: Initial undergraduate education expenses can be deducted as special expenses against taxable income.
taxTips.details: Applies to direct tuition, study materials, and loan finance charges under national tax codes.

taxTips.title: Section 24(b) - Interest
taxTips.description: Deduct up to ₹2,00,000 on home loan interest per year.

taxTips.title: Section 80C - Principal
taxTips.description: Save up to ₹1,50,000 on principal repayment per year.

educationAdvice.concessionDescription: Most Indian banks (like SBI, BoB, PNB) give a 1.00% p.a. interest discount if simple interest is serviced during the study period.
educationAdvice.bankingTip: Major Indian banks (SBI Student Loan Scheme, PNB Saraswati, Bank of Baroda) offer a 1.00% p.a. interest concession when simple interest is serviced during the moratorium period. Additionally, female students often qualify for an extra 0.50% concession under central schemes.

taxTips.title: Section 80E - Interest Deduction
taxTips.description: Entire interest paid during the financial year is tax-deductible.
taxTips.details: Available for up to 8 consecutive assessment years starting from repayment onset.

taxTips.title: Eligible Higher Studies
taxTips.description: Applicable for approved higher education programs for self, spouse, or children.
taxTips.details: Can be claimed by individual borrowers paying out of their taxable income.

taxTips.title: Transfer Duty Exemption
taxTips.description: Properties purchased for R1.1 million or less are 100% exempt from SARS property transfer duty.

taxTips.title: Section 13sex Residential Allowance
taxTips.description: Write off 5% of residential building costs annually over 20 years for landlords owning 5+ units.

educationAdvice.concessionDescription: South African commercial banks (Standard Bank, FNB, Nedbank, Absa) offer preferential interest rate discounts for academic excellence and regular debit orders.
educationAdvice.bankingTip: In South Africa, bank student loans require a sponsor or surety who services the monthly interest during your study term. Paying this interest promptly prevents compound balance inflation and grants a 6-month graduate repayment grace period.

taxTips.title: Section 10(1)(q) Bursary Exemption
taxTips.description: Bursaries or study loans provided by employers for employees or relatives are exempt from income tax.
taxTips.details: Subject to basic remuneration caps and bona fide educational program enrollment requirements.

taxTips.title: Section 18A Educational Donations
taxTips.description: Donations and financial support paid to registered Public Benefit Organisations (PBO) universities.
taxTips.details: Provides Section 18A tax certificates to deduct contributions from annual taxable income with SARS.

taxTips.title: First-Time Buyer Relief
taxTips.description: Zero stamp duty for first-time buyers on properties up to £425,000.

taxTips.title: Rent-a-Room Relief
taxTips.description: Tax-free income if you let out furnished accommodation.

educationAdvice.concessionDescription: UK private education lenders (like Future Finance, Prodigy) offer interest rate discounts (typically 0.25%–0.50%) when servicing interest during studies.
educationAdvice.bankingTip: In the UK, government Student Loans (Plan 2 & Plan 5) accrue interest linked to RPI during study, with repayments deducted via PAYE only when income exceeds the statutory threshold. For commercial study loans, servicing simple interest during term-time stops compound balance growth.

taxTips.title: Income-Contingent Repayments
taxTips.description: No repayments required if earnings are below the statutory threshold (9% of excess income).
taxTips.details: Unpaid government loan balances are cancelled after 30 to 40 years depending on repayment plan.

taxTips.title: Employer Training Exemption
taxTips.description: Work-related higher education costs paid by employers are exempt from income tax and National Insurance.
taxTips.details: Enables tax-advantaged professional degree upskilling under HMRC guidelines.

taxTips.title: Mortgage Interest Deduction
taxTips.description: Deduct interest on up to $750,000 of mortgage debt.

taxTips.title: Property Tax Deduction
taxTips.description: Deduct up to $10,000 for state and local taxes.

educationAdvice.concessionDescription: Most US lenders (like Sallie Mae, Discover, SoFi) offer a 0.25%–0.50% interest rate reduction for enrolling in auto-debit and making in-school interest payments.
educationAdvice.bankingTip: In the U.S., servicing interest while in school prevents unpaid interest from capitalizing onto your principal upon graduation. Most private lenders and federal loan servicers also provide a 0.25% interest rate discount for setting up automatic debit payments.

taxTips.title: Student Loan Interest Deduction
taxTips.description: Above-the-line IRS deduction on Form 1040 to reduce modified adjusted gross income.
taxTips.details: Applies to interest paid on qualified federal and private higher education loans.

taxTips.title: Education Tax Credits (AOTC / LLC)
taxTips.description: American Opportunity Tax Credit (up to $2,500) and Lifetime Learning Credit (up to $2,000).
taxTips.details: Subject to IRS income phaseout thresholds and qualified enrollment criteria.
